name: HomeICU
what_it_is: An open-source low-cost remote vital signs monitor built on ESP32, pairing a wearable wireless sensor tag with a Flutter mobile app to let clinicians track home patients.
modes: BLE base-station mode (app relays to cloud)
MQTT standalone mode (direct cloud, no phone)
constraints: Not approved for human use; no FDA/CE/HC certification
Lab evaluation by qualified engineers only
No blood pressure in Phase I
